The African National Congress is on course for a bruising result in South Africa’s local elections on Wednesday as voters go to the polls amid deep discontent over water outages, power cuts and crumbling infrastructure.
The former liberation movement, which Nelson Mandela led to power in 1994 at the end of apartheid as South Africa’s first black president, is still likely to be the largest party. topArticle.title: WHO, WIPO and the WTO to hold 13th Joint Technical Symposium on 25 November 2026
topArticle.description: The World Health Organization (WHO), the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the World Trade Organization (WTO) will hold the 13th Joint Technical Symposium on Enabling Ecosystems for Local and Regional Health Products Manufacturing: Considering the Role of Trade, IP, AI and Digital Innovation on 25 November 2026, hosted by WHO at the International Conference Centre Geneva (CICG). The deadline for registration is 23 November 2026.
topArticle.titleJa: WHO、WIPO、WTOが第13回合同技術シンポジウムを2026年11月25日に開催
topArticle.summary: WHO、WIPO、WTOは、ジュネーブで地域および現地の保健製品製造のエコシステムに関する第13回合同技術シンポジウムを開催する。
